lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 7 -- Short and Clear
lesson.grammar_point: can / can't for ability, permission and polite requests

listenings.text: Hi everyone, a short note before the global calls. If you can't hear the speaker, please write it in the chat. Do not wait. If somebody is on mute, we can lose two minutes, and we only have thirty. You can ask people to repeat, and you can ask them to speak more slowly. Nobody thinks it is a problem. Thank you.

Hello, this is the IT desk. About your question: yes, you can join the global forum from your phone, but you can't share your screen from the phone. You can share the screen only from the computer. If you can't connect, call me and I can help you in five minutes. Have a good meeting.

extra_audio.text: The video call starts at ten. Rodrigo cannot hear the other person. He asks her to check the microphone. She is on mute, and she turns it on. Now he can hear her, and the meeting starts.
